name: Aggregate designated-party ownership just below the threshold
description: Several designated parties each hold stakes that together reach but are individually below the threshold, or holdings sit at just under the limit.
fp: Minority stakes are routine in investments.

sources.text: OFAC, Guidance on Entities Owned by Persons Whose Property and Interests in Property Are Blocked (50 Percent Rule) (2014)
OFSI, UK Financial Sanctions General Guidance (ownership and control section)
FATF, Guidance on Beneficial Ownership of Legal Persons (2023)
